Prompts

```
['download a file from a URL to a local path using wget with resume support', 'validate MD5 checksums of files in a folder against a checklist.chk file', 'download Chameleon tokenizer files including text_tokenizer.json and vqgan checkpoint from a presigned URL', 'download a Chameleon model (7b or 30b) weights and config files from a presigned URL', 'run the download_data CLI to download Chameleon tokenizer and model files using a presigned URL']
```

```
{'download_file': 'download a file from a URL to a local path using wget with resume support', 'validate_checksum': 'validate MD5 checksums of files in a folder against a checklist.chk file', 'download_tokenizer': 'download Chameleon tokenizer files including text_tokenizer.json and vqgan checkpoint from a presigned URL', 'download_model': 'download a Chameleon model (7b or 30b) weights and config files from a presigned URL', 'run_download_data': 'run the download_data CLI to download Chameleon tokenizer and model files using a presigned URL'}
```
